items: 33 Magic and runes to cast telegrab, or 50 coins
Armour and weapons defeat a level 51 monster and run past level 72 monsters
rec: Teleport to any furnace such as glory for Edgeville teleport, Ectophial to Port Phasmatys or a Falador teleport
rewards: Access to the Werewolf Agility Course

st.t: Head to the Canifis bar and either buy the pickled brain for 50 coins, or telegrab it.
i: 33 Magic and runes to cast telegrab, or 50 coins

st.t: Talk to Dr. Fenkenstrain in Fenkenstrain's Castle, north-east of Canifis, to start the quest.

i: 33 Magic and runes to cast telegrab, or 50 coins

st.t: Go up the staircase to grab the items you will need.
Search the bookcase in the east room for Handy Maggot Avoidance Techniques.
Search the west bookcase for The Joy of Grave Digging.
Combine the two amulet by using one on the other.
Go back to the ground floor.
Talk to the Gardener Ghost behind the castle, at the north end of the grounds, while wearing your Ghostspeak amulet.
Go to the cross-shaped grave marker in the Haunted Woods, south-east of the castle and immediately east of fairy ring ALQ. Long-press the grave and choose Dig to get his head.
Use the decapitated head on the pickled brain to create a decapitated head.
Use the Star Amulet on the easternmost memorial, south-east of the castle, and push it to go in the caves.
Push the memorial south east of the castle.
Kill the level 51 Experiment north-west of the ladder to get a key.
Leave the caves by going north-west, be sure to pick up the key from the level 51 experiment.
Go up the ladder and walk north to the three graves. Long-press the west grave and choose Dig to get the torso.
Long-press the middle grave and choose Dig to get the arms.
Long-press the east grave and choose Dig to get the legs.
Deliver the body parts to Dr. Fenkenstrain, use a teleport to Fenkenstrain's castle or run back through the caves.
s: I have some body parts for you.

i: Armour and weapons defeat a level 51 monster and run past level 72 monsters

st.t: Get a needle and 5 threads and deliver them to Dr. Fenkenstrain.
Talk to the Gardener Ghost and ask for the shed key.
s: Do you know where the key to the shed is?

st.t: Unlock the shed next to the Gardener Ghost with the shed key and go inside. Open the cupboard and search it for a brush.
Grab 3 canes from the pile.
Use 3 canes on the brush one at a time.
Go upstairs to the first floor of the castle.
In the west room of this floor, use the extended brush on the centre of the fireplace to get the conductor mould.
Go to any furnace (the closest is in Port Phasmatys) and, with the conductor mould in your inventory, smelt your silver bar into a lightning rod.
Return to the castle and go upstairs.
Walk to the room furthest south on this floor and climb the ladder there to the roof.
Repair the lightning Conductor.
Go back down to the ground floor of the castle and talk to Dr. Fenkenstrain.
Go upstairs to the first floor to confront Fenkenstrain's monster.
Use the Tower Key on the metal door to the central room on this floor.
Go up the ladder.
Talk to Fenkenstrain's monster.
Go back to Dr. Fenkenstrain. Instead of talking to him, long-press him and choose Pickpocket. You need 25 Thieving.
